noRenewal.title: Nothing to cancel
noRenewal.body: Memberships here are passes you pay for once. They never renew and nothing is charged again, so there is no subscription to cancel.
noRenewal.ends: A pass ends by itself on its last day. To keep going after that, you buy a new one.

errors.studentRequired: Confirm your school email first to get the student price. Nothing was charged.
